summary: Independent review of Jinshu 86 owned units from Chonghua's funeral notices through the historian's appraisal (s0630–s0841, including s0842 永和十年). Every owned claim, hint, and person was checked against the Chinese text, not the English. Reign-year conversions rest on the chapter's own juxtapositions (永和十年 with 改建興四十二年為和平元年; 復稱建興四十三年; 改建興四十九年，奉升平之號; 興寧元年; 太和初; 太元元年; 隆安中) and on the IHNS era table plus the Jianxing-continuation page. Those AD figures are conventional regnal-year labels, not month/day proleptic-Gregorian event dates; Academia Sinica's Julian default is irrelevant here because no owned claim certifies a Western month/day. 淮肥 is yearless in Jinshu; the Palace Museum lemma places 淝水 in 太元八年 / AD 383, matching the certified westernYear without importing a day. Competing ZZTJ months (永和十一年閏月 for Zuo's fall) and ZZTJ 太和二年 / 晉記 太和三年 for Lian Qi remain unresolved in the extraction and were not adopted. Ages 十歲 / 年十四 / 十八九 / 年六十一 are preserved as text with no inclusive-age birth conversion. Retrospective Heping honors, 賜諡, 追贈, exemplar citations, and the closing appraisal are kept off life dates and active hints. Owned-unit deaths and ages for owned people are present; 郭氏 is correctly not killed by 欽等伏法. Person ids that split one historical figure (Zuo, Tianxi, Yaoling, Liu Su, Zhang Yong, Huan Wen, Li Yan, Lady Ma) are internally coherent and not merged. Chronology is supported.
